concept.title: Tide Bodysuit
concept.statement: A compression bodysuit with tidal panel mapping and controlled reflective finish so movement reads as light moving across water under club LEDs.
concept.inspiration_notes: Ocean glow at night without literal mermaid costume language. Architecture of waves as panel seams.

key_lines: diagonal tidal panels from left shoulder to right hip
leg cut that stays secure in motion
silhouette.coverage_notes: Full torso coverage; leg height set for dance security over pure minimalism.

materials.notes: Reflective ink or reflective tape only on selected panel edges so effect is directional under LED, not full chrome.

colorways.name: Abyss
colorways.description: Midnight teal body, cyan reflective edge lines, black binding

colorways.name: Reef
colorways.description: Black body, violet mesh inserts, cyan edge catch

colorways.name: Foam
colorways.description: Near-black body, pale cyan mesh, soft white-reflective micro edge

front.notes: Full front, arms relaxed, tidal diagonals readable

side.notes: True profile, panel depth and leg cut clear

back.notes: Zip path and back panel mapping

production.construction_notes: Panel-heavy; reflective application method must be confirmed with partner (ink vs tape vs laminate).
open_questions: Preferred reflective method that survives sweat and wash?
Can power mesh and compression body share a stable seam without pop at hip diagonal?

copy.short: Compression rave bodysuit with tidal panels and controlled LED-reactive edges.
copy.long: Tide is built for movement under club light. Diagonal panels map like current across the body. Matte compression keeps the silhouette sharp; selective reflective edges catch cyan and violet LEDs without turning the whole suit into a mirror. Designed by Cherry. Sewn by partners.
social_hooks: Built for the floor, not the filter.
Design by Cherry. Made with partners.
copy.care: Cold wash, hang dry, avoid high heat on reflective edges (method TBD with manufacturer).

rights.notes: Concept and direction by Cherry. Visuals AI-assisted under her direction.
